auth.accountLocked: Account temporarily locked after too many failed attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.

dashboard.title: All links
dashboard.subtitle: Redirects, shares and drop boxes, in one place.
dashboard.emptyBody: Redirects <r>/r/</r>, shares <d>/d/</d> and drop boxes <u>/u/</u> will show up here.

links.title: Redirects
links.subtitle: Short /r/ links that send visitors to the address of your choice.
links.emptyBody: Create a redirect to get a short link to share.
links.loadFailedBody: Check your connection, then try again.

form.createDescription: The short link will send visitors to this destination.
form.editDescription: Destination, slug, expiry and status can be changed at any time.
form.slugHelp: Leave empty for a generated ID. Letters, digits, "-" and "_".
form.slugEditHelp: Changing the slug breaks the link's previous address.
form.expiresAtHelp: Leave empty for a link that never expires.
form.disabledHelp: A disabled link answers "link not found".

delete.title: Delete this redirect?
delete.description: The link /r/{{slug}} will stop working. Its slug stays reserved and cannot be reused.

validation.destinationInvalid: An http:// or https:// address is expected
validation.expiresInPast: The expiry date must be in the future

linkStats.title: Clicks
linkStats.emptyBody: Clicks on the short link will show up here, by day, source and country.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Interface language and account security.
settings.languageHelp: Applies to the whole site, public pages included.
settings.passwordHelp: Changing the password signs out every other session.
settings.passwordRules: At least 12 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a symbol.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions are signed out.

validation.complexity: An uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a symbol

files.title: Files
files.subtitle: Every stored file, where it comes from and how much space it takes.
files.emptyBody: Files dropped into a share will show up here.
files.emptyOrphansBody: Every file belongs to an existing share.
files.loadFailedBody: Check your connection, then try again.
files.deleteDescription: {{name}} ({{size}}) will be permanently removed from storage.
files.inUseHint: This file is still attached to a share: remove it from the share instead.

errors.storageUnavailable: Storage is unreachable, try again in a moment.
errors.inUse: This file is still attached to a share.
errors.notReady: This file is not ready yet.

drops.title: Drops
drops.subtitle: /u/ links to receive files, up to a number and a size.
drops.emptyBody: Create a drop to get a link where files can be sent to you.

form.createDescription: Received files stop at the limits chosen here.
form.editDescription: Title, slug, limits and expiry can be changed at any time.
form.title: Title (optional)
form.titleHelp: To find it in the list.
form.slugEditHelp: Changing the slug breaks the drop's old address.
form.maxTotalSizeHelp: Sum of received files, up to 75 GiB.
form.expiresAtHelp: Suggested at 7 days. Leave empty for a drop that never expires.

delete.title: Delete this drop?
delete.description: The /u/{{slug}} link will stop working. Its slug will stay reserved.

errors.invalid: Invalid title, slug, limit or expiry.

shares.title: Shares
shares.subtitle: /d/ links to share one or more files.
shares.emptyBody: Create a share to drop files into it and get a link to send.

form.createDescription: You will drop the files on the share's page.
form.editDescription: Slug, expiry, downloads and state can be changed at any time.
form.slugEditHelp: Changing the slug invalidates the share's old address.
form.slugLocked: The slug cannot change during an upload.
form.expiresAtHelp: Leave empty for a share that never expires.

delete.title: Delete this share?
delete.description: The link /d/{{slug}} will stop working and its files will no longer be available. Its slug stays reserved.

files.title: Files
files.emptyBody: Drop a file above: it will be available on the link once verified.
files.name: Name
files.deleteDescription: {{name}} will no longer be downloadable from this share.

upload.dropTitle: Drop your files here, or click to choose them
upload.dropHelp: Up to 20 GiB per file and 50 files per share.
upload.cancelHelp: Cancels the upload and deletes what was already received.

errors.fileInvalid: This file was refused: invalid name, size or part.
errors.fileNotFound: This file or share no longer exists.
errors.fileConflict: This upload is no longer in progress, or parts are still missing.
errors.fileTooLarge: Too large: the file, share or storage limit was reached.
errors.storageUnavailable: Storage is unreachable, try again in a moment.
errors.differentFile: This is not the file of the interrupted upload: nothing was sent.
errors.hashFailed: This file could not be read.
errors.uploadInterrupted: Upload interrupted: check your connection, then resume it.

share.title: Shared files
share.verifyHint: Complete the check below to download.
share.verificationFailed: The check failed, please try again.

notFound.title: Link not found
notFound.body: This link does not exist, or is no longer available.

linkExpired.title: Link expired
linkExpired.body: This link has expired and no longer leads anywhere.

errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests, try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.tooManyRequestsNoDelay: Too many requests, try again in a moment.
